final_candidates.decision_summary: Corresponds to N501Y, forming optimal pi-pi stacking and packing interactions with ACE2 residues Y41 and K353 to drive substantial affinity gains.
Corresponds to Q498R, introducing strong electrostatic complementarity with the negative charge cluster on ACE2 (D38/E35).
Corresponds to Y453F, which optimizes hydrophobic packing against ACE2 H34 and consistently enhances receptor-binding affinity.

stop_reason.detail: Top-3 mutations are well-characterized high-affinity binders and further self-iteration yields diminishing returns.

history.rationale: Equivalent to Spike N501Y, which establishes enhanced pi-pi and hydrogen bonding interactions with ACE2 residue Y41 and K353, markedly increasing affinity.
Corresponds to N501Y, which establishes enhanced pi-pi and packing interactions with ACE2 Y41 and K353, exhibiting the highest affinity gain in DMS benchmarks.
Equivalent to Spike Q498R, introducing an arginine that forms strong electrostatic and hydrogen-bonding contacts with ACE2 D38 and Q42.
Corresponds to Q498R, forming favorable electrostatic interactions with ACE2 acidic patch (D38/E35), retained as a top-tier binder.
Equivalent to Spike N439K, which forms an additional salt bridge with ACE2 E329, measurably enhancing binding affinity.
Corresponds to N439K, introducing an additional salt bridge with ACE2 E329 that consistently enhances affinity.
Equivalent to Spike Y453F, optimized hydrophobic packing against ACE2 H34 while maintaining RBD fold stability.
Corresponds to Y453F, known to enhance ACE2 binding through improved hydrophobic packing with ACE2 H34.
Equivalent to Spike S477N, structurally stabilizing the receptor-binding motif loop and enhancing contacts at the ACE2 interface.
Corresponds to S477N, structurally stabilizing the receptor-binding loop flexible region and enhancing ACE2 contact near S19.
Equivalent to Spike T478K, introducing positive charge in the flexible loop region to enhance electrostatic steering toward ACE2.
Corresponds to T478K, introducing positive electrostatic complementary charge towards the ACE2 interface.
Equivalent to Spike L452R, improving hydrophobic packing and interface complementarity while preserving RBD expression.
Corresponds to L452R, improving interface stability and hydrophobic/electrostatic interaction.
Equivalent to Spike N501F, providing aromatic stacking comparable to N501Y that strengthens the hydrophobic interaction core with ACE2.
Corresponds to N501F, which increases affinity but is strictly dominated by the tyrosine substitution N171Y at the same locus.
Equivalent to Spike Q493R, which improves electrostatic complementary interactions with ACE2 E35.
Corresponds to Q493R, favorable for ACE2 charge complementation, though occasionally sensitive to local structural context.
Equivalent to Spike E484K, altering local electrostatics at the flexible ridge while maintaining tight ACE2 interaction.

Corresponds to E484K; while driven evolutionarily for antibody neutralization escape, deep mutational scanning demonstrates neutral to slightly deleterious effects on ACE2 binding affinity in isolation.

rejection.reason: Corresponds to E484K; while driven evolutionarily for antibody neutralization escape, deep mutational scanning demonstrates neutral to slightly deleterious effects on ACE2 binding affinity in isolation.
